title: 2013 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: When Clara totaled her scores, she inadvertently reversed the units digit and the tens digit of one score. By which of the following might her incorrect sum have differed from the correct one?

solutions.text:
If the last two digits of the score are \(10a+b\), then reversing those digits gives \(10b+a\). The difference is \[ \begin{aligned} &(10a+b)-(10b+a) \\ &= 9(a-b), \end{aligned} \] so the incorrect sum must differ from the correct sum by a multiple of \(9\).

Among the answer choices, only \(45\) is divisible by \(9\).

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Reversing tens and units changes a number by a multiple of \(9\).
Check which answer choice is divisible by \(9\).
